title: Article 227 — Power of superintendence over all courts by the High Court

content.overview: Article 227 provides that every High Court shall have superintendence over all courts and tribunals throughout the territories in relation to which it exercises jurisdiction (subject to parliamentary law excluding certain tribunals). The High Court may call for returns, make general rules and prescribe forms, and settle tables of fees. The power of superintendence does not include power over any court or tribunal constituted by or under any law relating to the Armed Forces.
content.glance: HC has superintendence over all courts and tribunals in its territories (except Armed Forces courts/tribunals). May call for returns, make rules, prescribe forms and fees.
content.study:
Article 227 superintendence is administrative and judicial in character and is distinct from appellate jurisdiction. It enables the High Court to keep subordinate courts and tribunals within the bounds of their authority. Armed Forces courts/tribunals are excluded.

Examination: superintendence (not merely appeal); all courts and tribunals in the territories; Armed Forces exclusion; rule-making and returns.

sections.heading: Key powers
sections.body:
1. Superintendence over all courts and tribunals in the HC’s territories.
2. Call for returns; make general rules and prescribe forms; settle tables of fees.
3. Exception: courts/tribunals under law relating to the Armed Forces.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What is the High Court’s power of superintendence under Article 227?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 227, every High Court has superintendence over all courts and tribunals throughout the territories in relation to which it exercises jurisdiction. It may call for returns from such courts, make and issue general rules and prescribe forms for regulating their practice and proceedings, and prescribe forms in which books, entries and accounts are to be kept. The power does not extend to courts or tribunals constituted by or under any law relating to the Armed Forces.

examTips: Superintendence over subordinate courts/tribunals; Armed Forces exclusion.

keyTakeaways: Art 227: HC superintendence over subordinate courts and tribunals.
